candidates.title: Stash
candidates.why: The only candidate that is already a dense reference tool: ruled section headers, bracketed pagers, Space Mono meta lines and one yellow accent, which map onto settings-value chips and a many-section nav.
candidates.leave: Slab wordmark (a logo); grey #8a8a8a deks below 4.5:1; motion 1 over budget 0.

candidates.title: GoShuin: Goshuin Map & Journal for iPhone
candidates.why: Restrained trust: hairline bronze rules, underlined text links, a pause-motion control and a Previous/select/Next paging bar for stepping through scenarios on a phone.
candidates.leave: 129px Georgia display, book-spread hero and dithered art; too editorial and airy; motion 1 over budget 0.

candidates.title: 一卦
candidates.why: A single-purpose tool built from system fonts only, so it loads fast in the field; hairline-framed header and footer, one black pill as the picker action.
candidates.leave: Radial glow and motion 2 over budget; airy centred column unsuited to tables.

candidates.title: Enric Badrinas
candidates.why: Strict economy: one grotesk at 16px, a two-link nav and monochrome black on white, which is the easiest to invert for the dark scheme.
candidates.leave: Photo-led hero and single type size; tables need a second size and weight; motion 1 over budget 0.

candidates.title: ALMADA LABEL
candidates.why: Plain grotesk UI with an ink-filled square button and no chromatic accent; the weakest fit, useful mainly as a button and nav reference.
candidates.leave: Full-bleed photo hero, italic serif labels, spaced wordmark; real faces unknown (Shopify aliases); motion 1 over budget 0.

combinations.label: A
combinations.character: GoShuin as-is: hairline rules, text-link buttons and paper/slate tones; calm and trustworthy, more editorial than technical.

combinations.label: B
combinations.character: System-sans UI with tracked-caps metadata over warm paper and near-black ink, with Stash's horizontal mono-titled cards for scenarios.

combinations.label: C
combinations.character: GoShuin's paging bar and hairline rules plus Stash's ruled section headers and bracketed pagers; the most navigable option.
